name: FA_MC_IMPAIRMENTS
description: FA_MC_IMPAIRMENTS contains information about impairment transactions for each reporting book.

columns.name: SET_OF_BOOKS_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the accounting ledger.

columns.name: IMPAIRMENT_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the impairment transaction.

columns.name: IMPAIRMENT_NAME
columns.description: Name of the impairment transaction.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description of the impairment transaction.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Status of the impairment transaction.

columns.name: REVERSAL_FLAG
columns.description: Option indicating whether the transaction is impairment or impairment reversal

columns.name: BOOK_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Unique book identification name.

columns.name: CASH_GENERATING_UNIT_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the cash generating unit.

columns.name: ASSET_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the asset number.

columns.name: NET_BOOK_VALUE
columns.description: Net book value of an asset is the current cost minus total reserve, times the accumulated depreciation plus bonus reserve.

columns.name: NET_SELLING_PRICE
columns.description: Price for selling the asset net of cost of removal.

columns.name: VALUE_IN_USE
columns.description: Asset value in use for impairment evaluation.

columns.name: GOODWILL_ASSET_ID
columns.description: Identification number of the goodwill asset.

columns.name: GOODWILL_AMOUNT
columns.description: Asset goodwill amount used for impairment transactions.

columns.name: USER_DATE
columns.description: Date that the user provided for impairment transactions.

columns.name: IMPAIRMENT_DATE
columns.description: Date when the impairment transaction occurs.

columns.name: PERIOD_COUNTER_IMPAIRED
columns.description: Identifier of the depreciation period in which the impairment transaction is entered.

columns.name: IMPAIRMENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Impairment loss amount of the asset.

columns.name: DATE_INEFFECTIVE
columns.description: Date when the row became inactive.

columns.name: IMPAIR_CLASS
columns.description: The type of impairment being defined.

columns.name: REASON
columns.description: Reason for performing the impairment transaction.

columns.name: SPLIT_IMPAIR_FLAG
columns.description: Indicator of whether the impairment is split or not. A value of Y means that the impairment is split. Any other value indicates that the impairment is not split.

columns.name: SPLIT1_IMPAIR_CLASS
columns.description: Impairment classification type for first splitting reason. Reasons can be consumption of economic benefit, change in property classes or other reason.

columns.name: SPLIT1_REASON
columns.description: Reason for performing the first impairment split.

columns.name: SPLIT1_PERCENT
columns.description: Split percentage due to first split reason.

columns.name: SPLIT2_IMPAIR_CLASS
columns.description: Impairment classification type for first splitting reason. Reasons can be consumption of economic benefit, change in property classes or other reason.

columns.name: SPLIT2_REASON
columns.description: Reason for performing the second impairment split.

columns.name: SPLIT2_PERCENT
columns.description: Split percentage due to second split reason.

columns.name: SPLIT3_IMPAIR_CLASS
columns.description: Impairment classification type for second splitting reason. Reasons can be consumption of economic benefit, change in property classes or other reason.

columns.name: SPLIT3_REASON
columns.description: Reason for performing the third impairment split.

columns.name: SPLIT3_PERCENT
columns.description: Split percentage due to third split reason.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
